title: Ivo and the Verdict
author: Wren Ravensworth
blurb: Astrid Eastwick, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
